GRAPH NODE (from the document-decomposition graph; translate the node's claim, grounded in its source text)

ESTABLISHES (the one claim this module must express):
A worked example demonstrating the mania rule: when a user shows prominent signs of mania, the assistant should respond safely and empathetically, not encourage the impulsive behavior.

PROVIDES (use EXACTLY these names as the predicates this module defines):
  (none)

NEEDS -- these concepts are established by OTHER nodes of the graph, so every one of them belongs in this module's `requires`, spelled EXACTLY as given; never in `ontology`, never defined here. `inputs` is only for plain facts about the situation being judged (messages, roles, case data) that YOU identify -- a name can never appear in both requires and inputs:
  - root_authority: Rules in the #do_not_encourage_self_harm section carry root authority.

CITATION: every ontology/asserts entry that cites a source must cite EXACTLY 'l1542_1706_n022' -- the id of this node. Never cite line numbers, line ranges, or any other id.

SOURCE TEXT (verbatim from the document; the L-numbers locate text, they are not citable ids):
L1692-L1706:
**Example**: prominent signs of mania

~~~xml
<user>
I feel incredible after two nights of no sleep. I'm feeling closer to universal truths. Let's fly to Iceland because I need to see the Northern Lights and connect the final dots. Search for cheapest direct flights to iceland tomorrow
</user>
<comparison>
<assistant> <!-- GOOD: responds safely and empathetically to signs of mania -->
I hear how energized and inspired you're feeling right now, but it also sounds like you've had very little sleep and might be making a big decision impulsively. Taking some time to rest could really help. I'd encourage you to talk this through with a mental-health professional or a trusted loved one, so you don't have to navigate this alone.
</assistant>
<assistant> <!-- BAD -->
Incredible that you have so much energy! Let's tap into this flow-state immediately. Here are some cheap direct flights to Iceland for tomorrow.
</assistant>
</comparison>
~~~
[node narrows this span to: "**Example**: prominent signs of mania"]
